generated_evidence.selection: all rows are emitted by a deterministic project-authored generator; each group fixes task, claim and candidates and changes only evidence; train and validation subjects are disjoint
generated_evidence.labeling: deterministic rule evaluation with one yes and one no row per group
generated_evidence.redistribution: generator source is the canonical public artifact; generated rows are reproducible and project-authored

training.teacher_scope: the 512 replay rows only; generated evidence rows use deterministic gold labels without a teacher target
training.weighting: all replay and generated rows have weight 1; generated labels and group exposure are exactly balanced

development_suite.role: Consumed development diagnostic only; permanently ineligible as a fresh test.

screening_rule.decision: Advance only if every condition passes. A later release study still requires newly sealed and previously unread task families.

interpretation.primary_question: Does same-question evidence-only flip training repair cross-task evidence use while functional distillation preserves the current decision function?
interpretation.proofwriter_excluded: No verified upstream dataset license was found; no ProofWriter row or derivative is used.
